state.task:
Question-answering task using the company document service.

The company handbook is held by a document service; it is not available as files. Documents
have a header line (version, status, effective dates, what they supersede) and numbered
sections; each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded
versions, and memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the
situation and date in the question.

Service actions (reply with one of these instead of "execute"):
  {"action": "search", "query": "lodging limit Geneva", "k": 5, "thought": "..."}
      up to k (at most 8; default 5) ranked passages with ids and document headers. Each
      result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (path in the result header),
      where your code can read it later.
  {"action": "fetch", "ids": ["HB-07 §2", "HB-12"], "thought": "..."}
      the named passages in full; a document id ("HB-12") returns all its sections; at most
      10 ids per fetch.
You can still use "execute" for code (for example to read saved results or manage your
context), and "final" to answer.

Questions:
- Q1: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan who works 16 hours a week today? (answer in EUR)
- Q2: What is the nightly lodging limit for a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q3: What taxi allowance applied to a daytime business taxi ride on 2026-02-15? (answer in EUR per ride)
- Q4: What is the paid parental leave for a primary carer in their first year of employment today? (answer in weeks)
- Q5: What is the relocation lump sum for a regular employee relocating at the company's request with dependent children today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the monthly parking allowance for a regular employee driving to the office today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR per month)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the rule
and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.query: monthly parking allowance employee driving to office

passages.source: HB-11 §2 | Facilities policy: parking — Standard monthly parking allowance | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-09-01 to the day before 2026-04-01 · superseded by: HB-23
passages.text: Employees who drive to the office receive a monthly parking allowance of 90 EUR. The facilities publishes worked examples of the monthly parking allowance on the intranet. The facilities reviews the monthly parking allowance once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-23 §2 | Facilities policy: parking — Standard monthly parking allowance | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-11
passages.text: Employees who drive to the office receive a monthly parking allowance of 60 EUR. Claims for the monthly parking allowance are filed in the expense tool under 'Facilities policy: parking'. The facilities reviews the monthly parking allowance once a year and announces changes in advance.

passages.source: HB-46 §2 | Memo: monthly parking allowance exceptions — Exception for employees at the city-centre office | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-09-01
passages.text: For employees at the city-centre office, the monthly parking allowance is 110 EUR per month instead of the standard amount. The facilities reviews the monthly parking allowance once a year and announces changes in advance. Each claim for the monthly parking allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier.

passages.source: HB-46 §1 | Memo: monthly parking allowance exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-09-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the monthly parking allowance in HB-23. Questions about the monthly parking allowance go to the facilities, who keeps the record of decisions. Managers confirm claims for the monthly parking allowance before payment in the next payroll run.

passages.source: HB-23 §1 | Facilities policy: parking — Scope | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-11
passages.text: This policy sets the monthly parking allowance for all employees. The facilities reviews the monthly parking allowance once a year and announces changes in advance. The facilities publishes worked examples of the monthly parking allowance on the intranet.

passages.source: HB-23 §4 | Facilities policy: parking — Exceptions | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-04-01 · supersedes: HB-11
passages.text: Group exceptions to the monthly parking allowance are published in HB-46. Each claim for the monthly parking allowance needs a receipt showing the date, the amount and the supplier. The facilities publishes worked examples of the monthly parking allowance on the intranet.
